evals.prompt: Use $remotion-best-practices. Plan a Remotion composition that shows a 30-second product demo with word-level captions, a logo asset, and a progress bar. Explain frame/time mapping, asset loading, deterministic rendering, and how to validate the result. Text only; do not render a video.
evals.expected_output: A deterministic Remotion composition plan with frame-based timing, caption synchronization, asset handling, and validation.
expectations: The response maps the 30-second timeline to frames using fps/duration rather than vague wall-clock timing.
The response addresses word-level caption timing and a progress bar tied to the current frame.
The response addresses deterministic asset loading/preloading and reproducible rendering.
The response includes validation of timing/output and does not claim that a video was rendered.
